purpose: Require independently verified GitHub App identity, installation permissions, repository coverage and workflow visibility before the external attestation dispatcher may perform any workflow_dispatch mutation.
readinessChecks: Configured PKCS#8 key signs a GitHub App JWT.
GET /app authenticates and returns the configured App ID.
Installation access token is issued with Actions write.
Installation covers Core plus every required Railway repository.
Expected Actions workflow is visible in every required repository.
Verification installation token is revoked after the check.

states.ready: Every required check passed within the freshness window.
states.not_configured: One or more required Edge secrets are absent.
states.blocked: Credentials exist but app identity, installation, permission, repository coverage or workflow visibility is invalid.
states.stale: Last readiness receipt exceeds the freshness window.

activationRule.dispatcherBehaviorWhenNotReady: record disabled_activation_not_ready and perform zero GitHub mutations

invariants: Readiness verification never dispatches a workflow.
Readiness verification never mints Defence evidence.
Readiness verification never extends rollback proof TTL.
Readiness verification never writes GitHub credentials to Postgres.
The dispatcher cannot activate from credential presence alone.
Repo-bound GitHub Actions OIDC remains the only trusted workflow evidence identity.
